audit.summary: Core conceptual bridge from influence signs to gradient outlyingness fails as stated: deletion sign is reversed, training-target gradients vanish at an exact ERM optimum, and the same gradient cloud can have opposite utility signs for different targets. Released evaluation mismatches and comparison overstatements are bounded secondary findings.

Limitations: The paper explicitly calls 3.2 a hypothesis and discloses class-conditioned LLM detectors; no universal failure of the heuristic or hidden-supervision allegation is made.
Limitations: Separate OpenReview attachments unavailable; no later erratum check or independent acceptance.

P1 — Influence-sign and gradient-outlier equivalence invalid — Counterevidence: Statement3.2 is explicitly a hypothesis; distribution adaptation is discussed. Regularized/nonconverged training does not necessarily have zero loss gradient. Synthetic plotting code uses positive loss-change sign. None establishes universal equivalence.

P2 — Release evaluation differs from described conventions and protocol — Counterevidence: Pinned source is not attested as historical experiment code; signed and absolute AUC can agree for some score arrays. No fabricated performance or deliberate leakage inferred.

P3 — Comparison prose and dense-Hessian complexity overstate evidence — Counterevidence: Several reported gains remain positive; means alone do not establish significance. No universal neural-network complexity formula asserted by review.
Limitations: Focused acceptance of reported issues only; initial full-paper coverage is not claimed as independently repeated.

proposition.claim:
Negative I=-v^T H^-1 g denotes detrimental samples; average ERM loss implies a small detrimental minority and enables gradient-outlier equivalence.

Released scripts implement the described common influence sign, absolute-score AUC and pretrained-model evaluation.

Proposed variant top2 at every budget and best Worst value; exact dense Hessian cost O(nv^3) where v=#validation and p=#parameters.

repair.content:
Remove leading minus or reverse inequality; specify utility and distinguish aggregate from self-influence. Gradient outlyingness remains an empirical hypothesis without additional target-alignment assumptions.

Document actual score convention, initialization and checkpoint selection; align implementation and text, then recompute matched comparisons if necessary.

Qualify rankings; for aggregate logistic target a direct dense implementation can use O(np^2+p^3+(n+v)p), subject to stated algebraic cost scope.
